caseNameFull: Sullivan v. Wirtz, Secretary of Labor
attorneys: Ruth S. Sullivan for petitioners., Solicitor General Marshall, Charles Donahue, Bessie Margolin and Robert E. Nagle for respondent.
judges: Below, Black, Certiorari, Jury, Right, Trial

opinions.text:
C. A. 5th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black, believing petitioners were wrongfully denied their constitutional right to a trial by jury, would grant certiorari and reverse the judgment below.
